messages:
Alex: Heads up — seeing a sudden spike of 5xxs and timeouts on hosted inference in eu-west starting ~09:12 UTC. p95 token latency jumped to ~12s. Support tickets trickling in :rotating_light:
Priya: On it. I can see a jump in request queue depth + a lot of 504s from the gateway. Pulling logs now.
Mateo: Looks like a KV cache miss storm — cache hit rate dropped from 98% to 45% for inference-kv-store in that region. Many warmup misses.
Jin: Are autoscaler events correlated?
ops-bot: [autoscaler] scaled service/redwood-hosted-eu-west from 6 -> 9 instances at 09:14:03 UTC (policy: latency).
Priya: Autoscaler did kick but nodes are slow to warm up because model cold-start + long sequence lengths.
Alex: Mitigation ideas: 1) route new traffic to m-small-v2 fallback variant, 2) temporarily increase max parallel requests per GPU, 3) pre-warm KV for top customers. Which is quickest?
Jin: I can flip routing to fallback model in the routing policy. Will do a canary 10% -> 100% if metrics look good.
deploy-bot: Routing change initiated: route:hosted/inference/* -> model:m-small-v2 (canary=10%).
Priya: Also, lowering request timeout to 30s for streaming requests to reduce tail backlog (from 60s).
Mateo: I'll run a quick KV pre-warm for the top 20 customer prefixes. Command: ```scripts/kv_prewarm.sh --region eu-west --prefix-file top20.txt```
Sam (support): I've pinged the three customers who filed tickets and told them we have an active mitigation. Keeping them updated.
Jin: Canary looks stable after 3 minutes — 5xx rate down by ~60% on canary traffic. Bumping to 50%.
ops-bot: [autoscaler] scheduled additional warmup tasks to populate KV on new instances.
Alex: Good. Bump to 100% and watch for any downstream billing/auth ripple.
Jin: Done — 100% traffic on m-small-v2. 5xxs trending down, p95 latency back to ~2.1s. :thumbsup:
Priya: Putting a short-lived tweak on circuit-breaker thresholds to avoid aggressive open triggers while warmup completes.
Mateo: Pre-warm finished for top customers. Hit rate recovered to ~93%.
Alex: OK, wrapping immediate mitigation. Opening postmortem checklist and assigning action items:
- Alex: write postmortem doc draft and timeline (ETA EOD)
- Mateo: implement automated KV prewarm on scale events (owner: Mateo)
- Jin: add fallback routing playbook + runbook steps for model variant swap (owner: Jin)
- Priya: add an integration test that simulates KV storm / cold-start alt path (owner: Priya)
- Sam (support): consolidate affected customers & escalate comms to account teams (owner: Sam)
Priya: Quick repro notes I saved: query used to surface issue:
```
SELECT time, kv_hit_ratio FROM metrics.hosted_inference_kv WHERE region='eu-west' AND time > now() - 15m
```
Alex: We'll also consider reducing default model cold-start penalties by shipping a smaller bootstrap checkpoint and improving kernel warmup. Adding to backlog.
Sam (support): I'll follow up with customers and attach incident summary once postmortem is ready.
Jin: I'll create the fallback routing playbook PR and link it in the postmortem.
Mateo: Starting a task to add prewarm to the autoscaler pipeline — ETA 5 working days.
Alex: Thanks all. Closing the active war room — follow-up postmortem in #postmortems and recurring ticket in backlog. :white_check_mark:
